title: Transcode job consumer with dead-letter topic
name: Transcode job consumer

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code makes sure failed transcode jobs end up in the dead-letter topic? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A job arrives whose codec is "vp6". Which path does it take through the error handler?
choices: It is retried with exponential backoff for up to a minute and then dead-lettered
It is dropped after being logged, because the listener swallows runtime exceptions
It skips the retries and goes directly to the recoverer, which publishes it to the dead-letter topic
It blocks the whole consumer group until an operator fixes the profile table

questions.prompt: TranscoderClient.submit keeps failing with 503s for one job. While the handler retries, what happens to other jobs on the same partition?
choices: They keep being processed, because retries are scheduled on a separate thread
They wait behind the failing record, since the default error handler retries in place and the offset is not advanced
They are copied to the dead-letter topic so they are not lost
They are processed out of order and committed first

questions.prompt: An engineer wants to replay dead-lettered jobs after fixing a bug. Which information does DeadLetterPublishingRecoverer provide to help with this?
choices: Nothing; only the payload is copied, so the original topic and offset are lost
Headers on the dead-letter record carrying the original topic, partition, offset and the exception details
A database row per failure, written by the recoverer
The record is moved, not copied, so the source topic no longer contains it
